holidays.name: National Llama Day
holidays.description: A day to appreciate llamas, the fluffy, long-necked, famously opinionated South American camelids. Celebrate by visiting a llama farm, wearing something woolly, or just spending the day appreciating a good llama hum.
holidays.origin: An unofficial observance of unclear origin, popular with llama fans and farmers.
holidays.funFact: Llamas are used as guard animals on farms, where they can protect sheep and goats from coyotes. They also hum to communicate with each other.

holidays.name: World Techno Day
holidays.description: A day for the pulsing, repetitive, bass-heavy music that got its start in the clubs of Detroit. Put on your headphones, turn up the beat, and let the four-on-the-floor rhythm run the day.
holidays.origin: An unofficial observance of unclear origin that honors techno music and the electronic music culture around it.
holidays.funFact: Techno grew out of Detroit in the 1980s, thanks largely to the Belleville Three: Juan Atkins, Derrick May and Kevin Saunderson.

holidays.name: National Pastry Day
holidays.description: A buttery, flaky, sugar-dusted day for croissants, turnovers, danishes, strudels and any other treat made of layered dough. It's a good excuse to pick up something from the bakery.
holidays.origin: An unofficial food observance of unclear origin, held in the sweet run-up to the winter holidays.
holidays.funFact: A classic puff pastry can have hundreds of paper-thin layers of dough and butter. Steam from the butter lifts those layers apart as the pastry bakes.
